correctness.rationale: Nerve face enumeration gives \(m=ab+1+2g\). The sink attachment graph has \(b+c\) vertices and \(ab\) edges; if disconnected it splits off \(q-1\) circles, prohibited by the nondegenerate \(H^1\) cup pairing of an orientable genus-\(g\) surface. Thus connectedness and \(H_2\cong\mathbb Z\) force \(a\ge2g+1\), and the opposite category forces \(b\ge2g+1\). The \(r=2g+1\) composition table attains equality. All other triangles collapse along unique leaf edges, leaving a connected orientable two-manifold with vertex-circle links and Euler characteristic \(2-2g\). The exact checker verified the incidence and orientation claims for genera 1 through 12. The theorem holds uniformly by proof, not finite testing.

value.rationale: This sharp infinite-family optimization refines the object-complexity invariant with a distinct morphism budget. The lower bound applies to every three-object model of a natural Poincaré-duality family, not one chosen construction. Its quadratic growth and structural source in the cup pairing motivate comparison between categorical compression and surface complexity.
